info.title: Sagat API
info.description: Multisig accounts, signer sets and proposals on Sui. Authenticate with the session cookie or a script token; both are issued by the `/auth` routes, which are shared with the legacy API.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Public keys registered with the service and the addresses they derive.

cookieAuth.name: connected-wallet
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by `POST /auth/connect`. Holds every key connected in the session.

bearerAuth.description: Script token from `POST /auth/script-connect`: a single key, valid for one hour. Takes precedence over the cookie.

error.example: Address is not registered in the system.

extraPublicKeys.description: More Sui public keys (base64, with their scheme flag) to register. Keys that fail to parse are skipped.

publicKey.description: The Sui public key, base64, with its scheme flag.

post.description: Registers the session's keys, and any extra keys passed, so they can be put in a signer set.

401.description: No session, or the session has expired.

get.description: The public key registered for a Sui address. An address is registered when its key connects, is passed to the register route, or is put in a signer set.

200.description: The address and its public key.

400.description: The address is malformed or not registered.
